meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: with lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation Off, "Add Columns" is not offered
gaps: Set or verify the company setting lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set or verify the company setting lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation is Off.

plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-046 Add Columns hidden in saved eRFX draft

steps.note: Start a new eRFX creation flow.
Provide the required event title before saving the draft.
Apply a pricing template so the draft has a configured eRFX sheet.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet and its column controls are available.
Complete the pricing sheet sufficiently for the draft to save.
Commit a schedule as required for a normal saved draft.
Complete the draft's participant setup without inventing a vendor name.
Save the eRFX as an unpublished draft.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab where the saved eRFX should appear.
Reopen the saved draft under test.
Assert that Add Columns is not offered on the reopened draft.
